message.headtap.golem_craftbow.golem_fai: Don't have enough materials to craft a golem.
tooltip.headtap.item.anvil_observer: Emits redstone signal when anvil lands on the block in front of it.
tooltip.headtap.item.bamboo_javelin: The less durability it has, the less damage it deals.
tooltip.headtap.item.builder:
Put an itemframe on top of this block, and put a multi-block crafting result in the itemframe will assign the recipe. 
Places blocks of the multi-block recipe when enough materials and redstone powered.
tooltip.headtap.item.distributor:
Distribute item inputs into two halves and output items through two faces. 
Disabled when redstone powered.
tooltip.headtap.item.entity_ejector:
Stores elastic energy when anvil lands on it, and ejects entity on it with that energy when redstone powered.
"Significant weightlessness!"
tooltip.headtap.item.golem_craftbow:
Right click to heal nearby Iron Golems with Iron Ingots. 
Shift + Right click to summon golems with material blocks.
tooltip.headtap.item.passive_royal_anvil: Functions as a Royal Anvil for items in it when hit by anvil.
tooltip.headtap.item.passive_royal_grind: Functions as a Royal Grindstone for items in it when hit by anvil.
tooltip.headtap.item.passive_royal_smith: Functions as a Royal Smithing Table for items in it when hit by anvil.
tooltip.headtap.item.printer: With books, blessed/cursed gold ingots in this block, copies the enchantment book upon this block when hit by anvil.
tooltip.headtap.item.resin_extractor:
Extracts resin from nearby tree when hit by an anvil.
Automatically outputs resin fluid to nearby cauldrons.
tooltip.headtap.item.resin_fluid_bucket: A cauldron of resin turns into a block when output via a hopper.
tooltip.headtap.item.stone_generator: When there are appropriate blocks and liquids around it, it generates stone when hit by anvil.
tooltip.headtap.item.variable_fluid_tank: When there are ore blocks around it, its storage capacity increases.
